items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: I was staying with Gene Ware and his wife, Zareta, and my, me and my wife, Alma, we were staying on Prairie and La Hoppe.

ctx.x: Is that Edna? No, not Edna.

No, not Edna. Willamina something. Willamina Borg. Yeah, Willamina Borg, yeah, yeah. So, uh, Danny was working up there and he hadn't so long, hadn't too long got married. And, uh, like he got married working on that job, yeah. So, he was good friends with Lee and also I was good friends with Danny, you know. So, they had a trip, this fella Sherman Cooks had a trip to, had an excursion trip to go to Chicago, you see. And, uh, Lewis Armstrong at the time was living in Chicago, you see. And, uh, Lee was telling me,…
You never did join the WPA band then?
